study type: Multicenter, open-label, parallel arms, randomized clinical trial
outcome: Glycemic control (mean glycemia, preprandial and postprandial)
cohort: 200 women with gestational diabetes needing pharmacologic treatment
finding: Metformin was associated with similar glycemic control to insulin, lower risk of hypoglycemia, less weight gain, and fewer cesarean deliveries, suggesting it is a safe and effective treatment option for gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were lower in the metformin group, and this was not associated with macrosomia or other complications.
